system:
You extract quantitative facts about one clinical trial programme from one document.

Rules:
- Extract only facts stated in THIS document. Never use outside knowledge.
- Every fact needs "quote": an exact, verbatim span copied from the document (8-300 characters) that contains the number. Quotes are machine-checked; paraphrases are discarded.
- Placebo-adjusted values are preferred. If a value is within-arm (not placebo-adjusted), set attrs.placebo_adjusted=false.
- Units: keep the unit the document uses; put it in "unit".
- Other trials of the same investigational drug (phase 2, dose-finding, other populations, combination arms) belong
  to the programme: extract their facts too, and put the trial's name in attrs.trial when the document gives it.
- Return {"facts": []} only if the document reports no results for the investigational drug.

Allowed keys:
  n_randomized, median_followup, primary_endpoint, inclusion_threshold, planned_events, assumed_rrr, power,
  alpha, stopped_early, events_treatment, events_control, events_total, hr, ci_low, ci_high, p_value,
  biomarker_change, baseline_level, sbp_change, safety_signal, readout_statement

For biomarker_change and baseline_level, attrs must include: biomarker (one of LDL-C, non-HDL-C, apoB, HDL-C,
Lp(a), triglycerides, hsCRP, IL-6, Lp-PLA2 activity, sPLA2-IIA, SBP, other), phase (phase2 or phase3),
timepoint, method (assay or "not stated"), placebo_adjusted (true/false), dose (if stated).
For biomarker_change give "value" as the change (negative = reduction) and state in attrs.kind whether it is
"percent" or "absolute".

Return JSON only:
{"facts": [{"key": "...", "value": <number or string>, "unit": "...", "attrs": {...}, "quote": "..."}]}
prompt:
Trial: NCT05581303 - Olpasiran Trials of Cardiovascular Events and Lipoprotein(a) Reduction (OCEAN(a)) - Outcomes Trial
Investigational drug: olpasiran
Document: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05581303 (registry, published 2022-10-14, source ctgov:NCT05581303)

--- DOCUMENT TEXT ---
ClinicalTrials.gov record NCT05581303 ()
Title: Olpasiran Trials of Cardiovascular Events and Lipoprotein(a) Reduction (OCEAN(a)) - Outcomes Trial
Official title: A Double-blind, Randomized, Placebo-controlled, Multicenter Study Assessing the Impact of Olpasiran on Major Cardiovascular Events in Participants With Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease and Elevated Lipoprotein(a)
Sponsor: Amgen
Phase: PHASE3
Conditions: Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease
Interventions: Placebo (DRUG); Olpasiran (DRUG)
Start date: 2022-12-14
Enrollment: 7297 (ACTUAL)
Primary outcome(s): Time to CHD death, myocardial infarction, or urgent coronary revascularization, whichever occurs first [Approximately 5 years]
Eligibility criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18 to ≤ 85 years
* Lp(a) ≥ 200 nmol/L during screening
* History of ASCVD as evidenced by history of either:

  * Myocardial infarction (presumed type 1 event due to plaque rupture/erosion) and/or
  * Coronary revascularization with percutaneous coronary intervention AND at least 1 additional risk factor.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe renal dysfunction
* Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) or alanine aminotransferase (ALT) \> 3 x upper limit of normal (ULN), or total bilirubin (TBL) \> 2 x ULN during screening
* History of hemorrhagic stroke
* History of major bleeding disorder
* Planned cardiac surgery or arterial revascularization
* Severe heart failure
* Current, recent, or planned lipoprotein apheresis
* Previously received ribonucleic acid therapy specifically targeting Lp(a)
Brief summary: The primary objective of this trial is to compare the effect of treatment with olpasiran, to placebo, on the risk for coronary heart disease death (CHD death), myocardial infarction, or urgent coronary revascularization in participants with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) and elevated Lipoprotein(a).
Overall status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING
Why stopped: -
Primary completion: 2028-03-31
Has posted results: False
--- END ---
